slides.title: A Toxic Invention
slides.text: The dark origins of a toxic word.
slides.speech: In 1879, a German journalist invented a pseudo-scientific word to rebrand religious hatred as racial science.

slides.title: The Dangerous Shift
slides.speech: Wilhelm Marr formed the League of Antisemites, replacing centuries of theological prejudice with dangerous racial theories.

slides.title: A Tragic Legacy
slides.speech: This linguistic shift transformed ancient suspicion into a deadly ideology that culminated in twentieth-century catastrophe.
